issues.concern: The English translation misrepresents the Japanese. The Japanese '話しかけの話題があった' means 'There was a topic I had started to talk about' or 'There was a topic that was being talked about (but not finished)'. The current translation 'There was a topic I had started discussing' implies a completed action or a different nuance.
issues.suggestion: There was a topic I had started to discuss (but not finished).
